texto.titulo: The lost wallet / A carteira perdida
texto.ru: First, I woke up late. Then I had a quick breakfast and ran to the bus stop. I used to take the bus every day, but yesterday it was late. Suddenly, I saw a wallet on the ground. Inside there was an ID card, so I took it to the police station. After that, I went to work. In the evening, the owner called me. He was very grateful, and finally we met and had a coffee.
texto.pt: Primeiro, acordei tarde. Depois tomei um café rápido e corri para o ponto de ônibus. Eu costumava pegar o ônibus todos os dias, mas ontem ele atrasou. De repente, vi uma carteira no chão. Dentro havia um documento, então a levei à delegacia. Depois disso, fui trabalhar. À noite, o dono me ligou. Estava muito agradecido e, por fim, nos encontramos e tomamos um café.
